name: 1inch
tagline: DEX aggregator for swap quotes and multi-chain routing
description: 1inch is a DEX aggregator API that finds optimal swap routes across decentralized exchanges. Used by wallets and trading UIs for quotes, token swaps, and liquidity routing on multiple chains.

auth.details: API key via Authorization header (Bearer or API key); self-serve signup at portal.1inch.dev

use_cases: get best swap quote for a token pair
list supported tokens on a chain
